programme.title: Combat Dealers S3 - "Channel Islands: Nazi Occupied Britain"
programme.desc: Bruce heads to a Martello Tower on the Channel Islands. Plus, the twins must get a WWII Napalm filled flamethrower ready for a buyer.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "Russia"
programme.desc: The remarkable story of how Stalin's massive war factories were dismantled and moved east on one and half million railway trucks, to avoid being lost to the Nazis.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Battle For Black Gold"
programme.desc: The story of the discovery and exploitation of the Baku Oilfields in the Russian Caucasus, which forced Stalin and Hitler to face-off in the battle of Stalingrad.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Fiat And The Fascists"
programme.desc: Find out how Fiat didn't just make cars: they made trains, they made planes, and like modern-day kingmakers, they made and broke governments too.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "The Science Of Water Sustainability"
programme.desc: Looking at solutions for water scarcity from fog catching nets to water efficient washing machines.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "The Science Of Sugar"
programme.desc: Exploring the correlation between sugar intake and heart disease in young adults.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "Saving The Reef"
programme.desc: A look at how cross-breeding and manipulating corals to withstand warmer sea temperatures and more acidic condition could save coral reefs.

programme.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "Zimbabwe"
programme.desc: The Great Seto Bridge in Japan and the Victoria Falls Bridge in Zimbabwe have more than one thing in common: they were built on dreams and are the only train connections between the two regions.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Bear Attack"
programme.desc: Nick and Laura create kick-ass tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears. They use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Then try to recreate a “miracle” arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Space As A Tax Haven"
programme.desc: For the ultra-wealthy, the best part of making money is avoiding taxes. Space could be an astronomical payday, but will all that profit slip by tax free?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "Silencing Terry"
programme.desc: Terry wants to demonstrate how Hollywood has used different objects to silence a gunshot, and he and Larry will take to the range to see which one is the most qualified to act as a silencer. Terry also has a sit-down with Joey Zasa from Godfather 3 (Joe Mantegna) to discuss what he thinks of Hollywood’s adaptation of the silencer.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "Meet the Smiths"
programme.desc: Terry finally gets to compare himself to Brad Pitt!! Terry and Larry test 3 scenes from action film Mr. and Mrs. Smith. Can a refrigerator or elevator door protect our heroes? Also, can you ignite a gas line with just a bullet? Larry may not look as stunning as Angelina Jolie, but he will help Terry find out the answers.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "Nightmare on Hollywood Weapons"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry get to test several scenes from Horror films! Terry wants to find out what is the best way to kill a Zombie, just in case he ever ends up in a Zombie Apocalypse, and they will test a scene from the horror classic, Freddie vs. Jason!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "All for One!"
programme.desc: Terry travels back in time to see if he can make it as a Three Musketeer! Can he throw his sword and kill the enemy? Can the cross that he wears around his neck stop a bullet? Can a lead ball ignite from a black powder ignite a carriage full of black powder and brandy? Terry enlists the help of his companions to find out!

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Across Continents"
programme.desc: Never in the history of humanity have so many of us been mobile. New innovations propel us into the world of self-driving cars and high-speed trains.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into the Skies"
programme.desc: Growth in air transportation is set to soar, carrying over 10 billion passengers every year by 2050. To cope requires us to radically rethink aircraft design. Join us as we look into the world's most innovative research and development labs.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into Space"
programme.desc: The most innovative area of human motion lies not on Earth, but with the exploration of space. Meet the private space entrepreneurs jostling to offer the tantalizing prospect of cheap, frequent travel beyond the atmosphere into Earth orbit.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Roads That Changed The World"
programme.desc: Chariots were the express vehicles of their day – but how did they work? And what about the roads, tunnels, and bridges that they relied upon?

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "The Great Wall of China"
programme.desc: Since the earliest civilizations, humans have needed walls to protect them.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Aluminium Cans, Cuckoo Clocks, Paddleboards"
programme.desc: An insight into how used aluminium cans are turned into planes and rockets, and the carving of a traditional Black Forest cuckoo clock.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Car Shredder, Sarees, Worcestershire Sauce"
programme.desc: How do they build the ultimate car crushing colossus? Plus, how do Lea and Perrins concoct their Worcestershire sauce?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Mardi Gras, Rock Candy, Dentures"
programme.desc: A look at how the amazing, and massive, decorations on Mardi Gras carnival floats are created, how rock candy is twisted together, and a look at how dentures are made.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Helmets, Tea, District Heating"
programme.desc: How do they harvest and treat the world's most expensive tea? Plus, how does the Siekierki power plant of Warsaw, Poland heat half the city's homes?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Royal Enfield, Art Fraud, Milk"
programme.desc: How do they engineer the latest incarnation of the classic Royal Enfield Continental GT motorbike? Plus, how do 'art detectives' spot a forgery?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Crash Testing, Delftware, Umbrellas"
programme.desc: How do they blend science and destruction at crash test centres? And how do they piece together the complex mechanism of a pocket sized umbrella?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Iron Ore, Wave Flume, Chandeliers"
programme.desc: How do they extract iron ore from one of the most remote mines on the planet? And how do they make chandeliers that are fit for a queen?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Oyster Knives, Stadium Lights, Diamonds"
programme.desc: How do they forge the blades to crack open oyster shells? Plus, how do scientists in a lab grow the synthetic diamonds of the future?

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Megafloods"
programme.desc: Witness the devastating destructive power unleashed by planet earth’s most valuable resource – water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "Winter In The Swiss Alps"
programme.desc: Get to know a comparatively unknown corner of Switzerland, the Jura region. The film is a journey of discovery into almost untouched nature in the change of the seasons. The Jura Mountains are the little brother of the Alps

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "The Jura Mountains"
programme.desc: The ibex, marmot, and European adder have all developed strategies to survive the alpine winter.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "Ticino"
programme.desc: Learn about four different regions of Switzerland. From the rugged mountains of the Ticino High Alps to the lovely Muggio Valley in the southernmost corner of Ticino, hardly any other canton is so full of contrasts.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "Water and Ice"
programme.desc: The river called Aare is the only body of water that runs through Switzerland. It rises from a source in the Bernese Alps and finally flows into the Rhine. The Aere offers an important habitat for flora and fauna.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage S1 - "Wild Rescue"
programme.desc: With so many animals living in the city, sometimes they get themselves into trouble. But help is never far away. In Anchorage the wildlife come first, with lots of organisations and people that are working hard to protect them.

programme.title: Rock of Ages S1 - "Granite"
programme.desc: In this episode we travel to Brittany to find – in Goethe’s words 'the underpinning of the earth' - Granite.

programme.title: Rock of Ages S1 - "Marble"
programme.desc: In this episode we travel through India searching for a rock that is converted by heat pressure within the earth to become what we call marble.
